data.name: Ajda
data.gender_notes: Ajda is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Ajda is derived from the Arabic word 'Ajid' which means 'to worship'. The name is commonly given to girls in the Islamic world. It is a spiritual name that symbolizes dedication, faith, and devotion to God. The name Ajda carries the meaning “Devout, Worshipper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ajda usually hope their child will grow to embody devout, worshipper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder to remain steadfast in faith and worship.
data.etymology: Ajda belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Devout, Worshipper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ajda total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_urdu.name: اجدہ
